objective: Characterize the saved task-0 joint timeouts using only compact action/state dynamics summaries, without replay or exporting raw trajectory data.

hypothesis.claim_to_test: The four joint task-0 losses reflect grossly collapsed/low-motion control outputs rather than merely taking longer to reach success.
hypothesis.falsifier: For any of the four paired losses, the joint final-40-row median applied-action L2 norm over dimensions 0..5 is at least half its matched single-task control value; this falsifies the predeclared all-four gross-collapse pattern.
hypothesis.interpretation_limit: Descriptive n=4 saved-trace comparison only; cannot identify a causal multi-task mechanism, establish action-to-state replay parity, or change a progression gate.

options_compared.option: Stop after the existing terminal-timeout profile.
options_compared.reason: It locates the outcome at max-step timeout but cannot distinguish low-motion control from sustained unsuccessful motion.

options_compared.option: One bounded read-only CPU summary of pinned saved actions and robot-state path metrics.
options_compared.reason: Can test a narrow, falsifiable gross-action-collapse hypothesis at zero GPU cost while keeping raw traces on the private server.

options_compared.option: Start another training, policy evaluation, or simulator replay.
options_compared.reason: Would consume compute and confound the immediate saved-trace diagnosis; no new training/evaluation budget is registered here.

scope.source_artifacts: Eight already-saved action CSVs (single/joint per paired loss), each SHA-256 checked against the frozen 40-trace manifest before reading.
metrics: applied_action_0..5 L2 norm median/p90 over all rows and the predeclared final 40 rows
fraction of applied_action_0..5 rows with L2 norm below 0.01 in the final 40 rows
robot end-effector state path length and start-to-end displacement from state_7..9

execution_bounds.output: Compact aggregate JSON only; no raw action vectors, states, videos, trajectories, logs, model, or dataset leave the private host.

stop_conditions: SSH/authentication failure, source-manifest identity mismatch, any selected CSV hash mismatch, unexpected schema/non-finite values, or time budget exceeded.
On any failure, preserve source files, record the failure locally, and do not automatically retry or create a successor version.
